title: Clearing a unary tape
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean input, let $p$ be an input-head position, and let $T_0,T_1,T_2 : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and $h_0,h_1,h_2 \in \mathbb{Z}$ be the contents and head positions of three work tapes. Choose an output word $O$ and a tape index $t \in \{0,1,2\}$. For every $j \in \mathbb{N}$, if the machine starts in state $\mathrm{clW}(t)$ with tape $t$ containing a $1$ at exactly the cells $0,\ldots,j-1$ and its head at $j-1$, then after $j+1$ steps it is in state $\mathrm{clS2}$ if $t=1$ and in state $\mathrm{inc}$ otherwise; tape $t$ is blank everywhere with its head at $0$, while the input-head position, the other work tapes and their head positions, and the output word remain unchanged.
